<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0232026-10-0503-33-40" status="unreviewed">gsum pa rtags kyi mtshan nyid tshul rgyu
               <lb n="92b3"/>nges par bsgrub pa ni tshul gnyis su bsgrub pa dngos dang | tshul gnyis kyi nang tshan dgag mang | rang lugs la mtshungs pa spang pa las | 
               <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs></note> dang po ni rtags rtsod gzhi la mthong ba'i phyogs chos dan myi mthun ba'i phyogs la 'jug mi srid par nges pa'i ldog pa ste tshul gnyis kho na rags kyi mtshan nyid yin no || </seg></TEI>
